votes.motion: Grant the variances for 181 Hollis Road (soil depth, groundwater offset, inlet and outlet tee distance) on the condition that monolithic tanks with rubber boots on the outlets be used.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the variances were granted with the condition that monolithic tanks be used with rubber boots on the outlets. all in favor.

votes.motion: Action on the 136 Highland Street request for a variance to groundwater offset from five feet to three feet (motion wording not printed).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by fortin and second by jewell. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the request to extend the time to make repairs at 134 Kilburn Street.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by fortin the request to extend the time to make repairs was approved. all in favor.
